What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?

Hi! Once an order has already shipped, it can’t be changed anymore — that includes the shipping address, items, or cancellation. 📦

If the package is going to the wrong address and you won’t be able to retrieve it, you can file a shipping claim at claims.simplemodern.com.

If you want, send me your order number and I can help with the best next step 🙂

turns.q: Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
turns.replyTail:
mbine two separate orders into one shipment?

Hi! We’re usually not able to combine two separate orders into one shipment. 📦

Our orders move through fulfillment pretty quickly, so each order is typically processed on its own.

If both orders were just placed, you can check the confirmation email for each one and use the “Edit or View your order” button if that option is still available. Otherwise, they’ll ship separately.

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!

Can I change the payment method on my order?

Hi! You usually can’t directly change the payment method on an order after it’s placed.

If it’s still within about 40 minutes of purchase, I may be able to help cancel it so you can place a new order with the correct payment method. If it’s past that window, the payment method can’t be changed.

Send me your order number and I’ll check the best option for you 🙂
